steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A polis (city-state) was the fundamental political unit of ancient Greece, typically consisting of a city and its surrounding countryside | Key Fact: Each polis was self-governing with its own laws, customs, constitution and patron deity | Key Fact: Citizens (free adult males) had political rights and duties; women, slaves and metics (foreign residents) were excluded from citizenship | Key Fact: The acropolis (high city) was the religious and defensive centre; the agora was the marketplace and civic meeting place

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from greek city-states (poleis), and one past-paper question.
